decisionSection.title: When to choose liners vs. simulation
decisionSection.description: Live-fire liners and fire simulation serve different training goals. Many agencies combine both — here's how to decide.
decisionSection.linerTitle: Choose interlocking liners / live fire when…

chooseLiner: Training fire behavior, flashover recognition, and hose stream tactics
Building or retrofitting a dedicated burn room or CFBT facility
Needing realistic heat, smoke layers, and structural fireground conditions
Running advanced interior attack and ventilation control drills
chooseSimulation: High-frequency equipment handling and initial attack training
Indoor or densely populated sites with strict emissions requirements
Public education, workforce training, and evacuation drills
Needing rapid reset between sessions without solid fuel or liner wear
Complementing live-fire facilities for routine, cost-effective drills

rows.traditional: Large-area removal required; high repair cost

rows.interlock: Calcium-silicate material; excellent back-face temperature control
rows.traditional: Cracking and insulation degradation over time
Heat transfers to structure after cracking

rows.interlock: Withstands repeated high temperatures; long-term stability
Upgrade path for existing burn rooms
